name: Tinybones
description: Tinybones is a tiny animated skeleton thief from Urborg on Dominaria who steals to feed his ersatz family.

timeline.summary: Tinybones pulls off the greatest heist of all time.
timeline.quote: To Tinybones, it was the greatest heist of all time.

citation.text: Pilfer (Dominaria United, 2022), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Annie meets Breeches, Malcolm and Tinybones at the Wildcard Saloon, where Oko is waiting behind the bar.
timeline.quote: "Care for a drink?" Oko's voice sounded from behind the bar.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Disguised as a courier, Oko enters Sterling Company headquarters carrying a box with Tinybones inside.
timeline.quote: The moment he stepped over the threshold, Oko surveyed the room.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Tinybones emerges from the box in Graywater's office and Umezawa finds Oko there.
timeline.quote: Tinybones burst from the lid, partially disassembled.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Oko and Tinybones knock out Ral's guard and flee, Oko taking eagle form.
timeline.quote: He shapeshifted into a large eagle

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Surrounded by Sterling guards, Oko is saved when Kellan throws the guards back with golden vine-shaped magic.
timeline.quote: Confusion swirled through Oko's mind until he realized the magic was coming from Kellan.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Tinybones frees the crew with a key, and Vraska petrifies the Hellspurs guarding them; Oko reveals he planned this.
timeline.quote: locked eyes with one after another until all of them were stone.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 5: High Moon
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 5: High Moon" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Oko refuses to go back for Kellan and Annie reluctantly goes on to the vault.
timeline.quote: There was no time for a rescue mission tonight.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 5: High Moon
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 5: High Moon" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Oko's reunited crew enters Maag Taranau, with the silent Annie leading them through traps.
timeline.quote: Annie's left iris glowed a vivid orange as she approached the outer entrance.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Umezawa explains the dual-lever trap, and Tinybones is guided across the light grid with a dragonfly device.
timeline.quote: Annie did a few practice turns in the air before sending the dragonfly to the edge of the platform.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Tinybones and Umezawa pull the levers together and disarm the light grid.
timeline.quote: They pulled the levers in unison.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: The crew flees the collapsing vault on Rakdos's back.
timeline.quote: The team fled back through the corridor as the sound of the vault being ripped apart roared behind them.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Oko returns to the Wildcard Saloon and tells the crew that Vraska and Ashiok betrayed them.
timeline.quote: "Vraska and Ashiok were always planning to double-cross us.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Oko disbands the crew with the promise of a future reunion, deciding to leave Kellan and Annie alone.
timeline.quote: "No. From now on, their business is their own,"

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Ral Zarek arrives with Sterling mercenaries and strikes Akul; Tinybones frees the captives and Vraska petrifies their captors.
timeline.quote: he was struck by thunder as Ral Zarek arrived with Sterling mercenaries

citation.text: "Annie Flash", section "Working with Oko". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ashiok hires Oko for a heist of Maag Taranau, and they gather an outlaw crew.
timeline.quote: he was contacted by Ashiok and hired to perform a heist to steal the contents of Maag Taranau

citation.text: "Oko", section "Thunder Junction heist". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oko and the crew steal a vault key from Bertram Graywater's office.
timeline.quote: they secured the key

citation.text: "Oko", section "Thunder Junction heist". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oko plans to infiltrate Tarnation, secretly arranging for his team to be captured and the Sterling Company raid.
timeline.quote: he submitted an anonymous tip about Tarnation's location to the Sterling Company so they would raid the city

citation.text: "Oko", section "Thunder Junction heist". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Akul combines Oko's key with his five; Kellan challenges Akul to a duel, and Oko uses the Sterling raid to steal the full key.
timeline.quote: Oko had Tinybones unchain him and steal the complete key, making for the vault.

citation.text: "Oko", section "Thunder Junction heist". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oko forms a gang with the Multiverse's most wanted to pull off a heist of epic scale.
timeline.quote: Oko has formed a gang with the Multiverse's most wanted (a.o. Tinybones , Vraska , Rakdos and Annie Flash ) to pull off a heist of epic scale.

citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction", section "Storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oko recruits Rakdos for his heist of Maag Taranau on Thunder Junction; Rakdos knocks away Ral Zarek and defeats Akul.
timeline.quote: Oko recruited Rakdos for his heist of Maag Taranau

citation.text: "Rakdos (character)", section "Thunder Junction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oko recruits Tinybones for a heist on Maag Taranau; Tinybones travels to Thunder Junction through an Omenpath.
timeline.quote: Tinybones traveled through an Omenpath to the plane and joined the crew.

citation.text: "Tinybones", section "Thunder Junction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tinybones and Oko raid the Sterling Company headquarters and obtain a vault key, but Oko's illusion fails at the sight of Kellan.
timeline.quote: The plan succeeded in obtaining the key

citation.text: "Tinybones", section "Thunder Junction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oko wears Tinybones as bone armor to be captured on purpose; Tinybones undoes his chains and they make a break for Maag Taranau.
timeline.quote: Tinybones undid his chains, and along with Oko made a break for Maag Taranau.

citation.text: "Tinybones", section "Thunder Junction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tinybones helps navigate the vault's traps and escapes after Akul assaults them.
timeline.quote: Tinybones helped navigate the maze of traps within the vault of Maag Taranau

citation.text: "Tinybones", section "Thunder Junction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tinybones departs for further adventures with Rakdos.
timeline.quote: Tinybones departed for further adventures with Rakdos
